title: WHITE CITY & VOLCANOES
description: Discover the White City of Arequipa and challenge the surrounding volcanoes. A tour that combines colonial architecture with high mountain adventure.
shortItinerary: Day 1: Arequipa City Tour - Santa Catalina Monastery

itinerary.title: Arequipa City Tour
itinerary.description: Tour of the white city: Plaza de Armas, Cathedral, Santa Catalina Monastery, and viewpoints with volcano views.

itinerary.title: Misti Volcano Ascent
itinerary.description: Full-day trekking to the crater of Misti volcano (5,822 m). Impressive volcanic landscapes and panoramic views.

itinerary.title: Imata Canyon - Return
itinerary.description: Visit to the impressive Imata Canyon with unique rock formations. Return to Arequipa in the afternoon.

recommendations: Good physical condition for the ascent
